scope: Fresh untrained connectome material-response identification authorized by user; no capability experiment
problem_formulations: Anatomical delayed reachability versus actual thresholded transmission
Driven material response versus writer adaptation of the imposed source
Periodic motor observation versus recurrence of the full dynamical state

architecture.weights: All nn parameters freshly initialized from specified seeds; no pretrained embeddings or learned checkpoints; anatomy graph buffers from original NPZ

amplitude_levels: inverse median positive first-tick (beta_int*packet/theta) using first selected token at rest
backgrounds: same 128 real tokens, native amplitude1, one tick/event, no updates
periodic_modes: raw packet at zero baseline repeated, open-loop source intervention
execution.periodic_background: rest only, native amplitude1 in both modes

hypotheses.prediction: Native sensory spikes absent but analytic first-tick threshold calibration creates spikes and later motor response; active sensory spikes without motor response shifts explanation to transmission/inhibition.
Native input energy and motor response change across cycles more than fixed raw-packet input; paired input ledger isolates differing imposed source, not equal-energy causation.
Matched pulse versus quiet contrast differs between resting and 128-token conditioned states, across several initialization seeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Slow ALIF/STP adapts even under constant repeated packets
hypotheses.prediction: Constant input energy accompanied by b/x/u/ring boundary changes and motor response changes locates continued internal adaptation.
Actual motor waveforms and same-phase full states approach recurrence together above same-input replay floor. Six cycles with drift show only incomplete finite-horizon recurrence.

controls: Exact native production-event versus observed custom-tick all-state gate
Matched quiet counterfactual for each physical background
Same-input replay for each pulse and periodic schedule
Motor pre-reset voltage, post-reset voltage, E/I conductance, sensory/motor/whole-brain spike rates
Actual input squared norm, signed sensory mean and baseline magnitude
Parameter hashes before/after each seed, no optimizer or checkpoint
Memory guard reserved3900MiB and device used4GiB
Matched quiet controls also replayed; impulse resolution uses summed stimulus/control replay error
stopping: Fixed seeds/cadences/cycles only; abort nonfinite/interface mismatch/source mismatch/memory violation; no post-result extension
claim_limits: Model-initialization-specific conduction and driven adaptation, not native biological Hz, semantic capability, unique architecture prescription, infinite-time stability or endogenous resonance
prior_access: Mature-individual response results previously seen. Fresh-weight results unseen; hypotheses registered before fresh execution.
